code.description:
The problem code of its error (`SH1002`), or of its failure when
it ran and failed on the setup (`doctor`); `shuyi explain <code>`
prints its page.

error.description: Why it could not run, if it could not.

help.description: How to fix it, with the code.

limits.description: What it could not determine, in plain words.

ok.description:
Whether it passed: nothing found by a check, runs that agree, a
game made, a toolchain complete. False too when it could not run.

result.description: What it found or made; absent when it could not run.

Problem.description: A problem in a file: what a validator found, with where.

code.description: Its problem code (`SH2001`), if its class has one.

file.description: The file, as the game shows it (`files/stage.map`).

help.description: How to fix it, with the code.

length_ms.description: How long it plays, in milliseconds; 0 with problems.

peak.description: Its loudest sample, 0 to 32 767; 0 with problems.

problems.description:
Every problem with a file's numbers, each with its line: none
passes. Nothing is written when there is one.

samples.description:
How many samples it renders to, mono at 44 100 a second; 0 with
problems.

text.description:
The sound's text, as `out` writes it: a preset's with a line naming
it, a file's in the form the engine writes. A file with problems
gives its own text.

written.description: The files written (`out`, then `wav`), as given.
